inject_catalog.name: 向角色播报衣橱
inject_catalog.hint: 在系统提示中附加当前可用的穿搭与场景目录，角色便会主动用 <dressup> 标签换装自拍。

en.name: Announce wardrobe to the character
en.hint: Append the current outfit and scene catalog to the system prompt so the character can dress up via the <dressup> tag.

merge_references.name: 合并穿搭参考图
merge_references.hint: 自拍选中多件穿搭时，用 Pillow 拼成一张带名称标签的穿搭单再传给模型（场景保持独立），适合参考图数量有限的图像模型。

en.name: Merge outfit references
en.hint: Compose multiple selected outfits into a single labelled sheet with Pillow before sending (scenes stay separate). Useful for image models with a limited reference count.
